characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model's March Rate is set to 16" and it gains Fly (8", 16") and Light Troops.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The unit can never benefits from Commanding Presence or Rally Around the Flag. The unit gains +1 Discipline for each Full Rank.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Attack Attribute

If the model's unit has at least one Full Rank, the model's Impact Hits cause an additional D3 hits for each model in the same file behind it (normally 2D3/3D3/etc. instead of D3).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model's base size is changed to 50×75mm and its Discipline is set to 7.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Attack Attribute

Close Combat Attacks and Shooting Attacks from Short Range made by the model part gain Lethal Strike (against Beast, Cavalry).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Attack Attribute

The model part gains Battle Focus and Hatred while joined to one or more R&F models with Makhar Battle Fever.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The Makhar Gyula gains +1 Attack Value and may take Special Items for an additional 50 pts. Model parts with Makhar Battle Fever and without Harnessed in a unit that contains Stallion's Tempest gain Battle Focus.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The Makhar Gyula gains +1 Attack Value and may take Special Items for an additional 50 pts. The model's Commanding Presence range is increased by 6".

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model's Health Points are set to 8, and its base size is changed to 75×100 SI. The model gains Maximised (Stomp Attacks).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Close Combat Weapon

Attacks made with this weapon gain +1 Strength and +1 Armour Penetration.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Close Combat Weapon

Attacks with a Tribal Warspear gain +1 Strength and Multiple Wounds (D3, against Towering Presence). Charging enemy units in base contact with the wielder suffer -1 Agility. The wielder gains Exclusive (Tamyr Vassals), Not a Leader, and War Platform.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Armour Equipment

Plate Armour. The wearer's model gains Aegis (5+, against Toxic Attacks).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

Units with more than half of their models with Path of the Favoured must reroll failed Break Tests. In addition, model parts with Path of the Favoured upgraded to a Champion additionally gain +1 Health Point to a maximum of 3, and their Discipline is set to 9.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model's March Rate is set to 20" and its Armour is set to 3.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Units with more than half of their models with Makhar Battle Fever must reroll any natural rolls of ‘1’ when rolling for Charge Range. In addition, the model gains Devastating Charge (Fearless, Hard Target (1)).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: As a special Charge Reaction, a unit containing at least one model with this rule may declare a Parting Shot Charge Reaction. All models with Parting Shot in the unit perform a Stand and Shoot Charge Reaction. Immediately after this, the unit performs a Flee Charge Reaction.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Bow. Attacks made with a Recurve Bow gain Quick to Fire. Furthermore, when shooting from Short Range, they gain +1 to hit and +1 Armour Penetration.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Lance. Attacks made with a Makhar Lance gain Fight in Extra Rank and Two-Handed.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer's model gains +1 Armour, up to a maximum of Armour 4, and -2" March Rate.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Place a round Tornado Marker with a 3" diameter with its centre on the target point. The Tornado Marker must be placed more than 1" away from any unit. The marker is considered Covering Terrain for units inside and/or behind them that contributes to ⟨Soft⟩ {Hard} Cover.
The Tornado Marker is Dangerous Terrain (⟨2⟩ {3}), even for models with Strider.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: This weapon has Shots 4, Str 4, AP 1 and always hits on 3+. Attacks made with this weapon gain Flaming Attacks and Magical Attacks. A unit that is hit by these attacks loses Soft Cover until the end of the Player Turn (if it had it). If the enemy unit was in Hard Cover, it is now considered to be in Soft Cover until the end of the Player Turn.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Attacks made with this weapon gain Devastating Charge (+2 Str, +2 AP) and become Magical Attacks. The weapon can be used as a Shooting Weapon (3+) with the following profile: Range 18", Shots 1, Str 3 [6], AP 10, Area Attack (1×5), Reload!, [Multiple Wounds (D3)]. This Shooting Attack never suffers negative to-hit modifiers.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: When using this weapon, the wielder gains +2 Attack Value, +2 Agility, and Magical Attacks. Close Combat Attacks made against the wielder's model gain +1 to hit.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer's unit gains Strider (Ruins). After determining Deployment Zones (at the end of step 6 of the Pre-Game Sequence), you may choose a single Field or Forest Terrain Feature that becomes Ruins. The bearer's unit gains Flaming Attacks in the First Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The wearer gains +1 Armour. Attacks against the wearer can never have a Strength above 5.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Model parts without Harnessed in the bearer's unit gain Devastating Charge (Lightning Reflexes).
